findings.title: Free shipping not applied at $100 threshold
findings.explanation: The acceptance criteria state that orders of $100 or more should ship for free, but the implementation only returns free shipping when the total is greater than 100, excluding orders exactly equal to $100.

evidence.quote: Orders of $100 or more ship for free.

limitations: The supporting code defining SHIPPING_FEE and any surrounding context was not provided, so we cannot assess other aspects of the function.
missing_inputs: No supporting code was provided; only the diff is visible.
